acceptance_criteria: Creating Project execution state without Project ownership is rejected.
invariants.statement: The Project is ARTIFEX's fundamental durable engineering unit.
invariants.title: Project-centricity

acceptance_criteria: Direct client/provider/file mutation cannot create an accepted semantic revision.
invariants.statement: Only Project Authority may accept a semantic Project mutation.
invariants.title: Singular semantic authority

acceptance_criteria: External Git edit becomes Observation/Proposal, not automatic acceptance.
invariants.statement: Git/files are durable portable representations of accepted semantic Project truth but do not independently confer authority.
invariants.title: Portable accepted representation

acceptance_criteria: External edit produces divergence/proposal.
invariants.statement: Direct repository, frontend and provider outputs require reconciliation/acceptance.
invariants.title: External mutation is proposal/observation

acceptance_criteria: Rebuild runtime state without losing accepted semantic Project decisions.
invariants.statement: Accepted semantic decisions may not exist only in RunStore/cache/provider state.
invariants.title: No database-only semantic truth

acceptance_criteria: Close clients and later Continue X successfully.
invariants.statement: Conversation history is never required for Project continuity.
invariants.title: Conversation independence

acceptance_criteria: Client claim cannot bypass Project Authority.
invariants.statement: Interaction clients are not Project authority.
invariants.title: Frontend neutrality

acceptance_criteria: Project remains open/usable with optional providers absent.
invariants.statement: No current provider is structurally mandatory to Project semantics.
invariants.title: Provider neutrality

acceptance_criteria: Fresh-machine Codex/Claude works with ATLAS absent.
invariants.statement: ARTIFEX Core works without ATLAS or advanced developer infrastructure.
invariants.title: Standalone operation

acceptance_criteria: Close frontend during Run; state/work continues as authorized.
invariants.statement: Authorized execution survives interaction-client lifecycle.
invariants.title: Persistent supervised autonomy

acceptance_criteria: Autonomous dispatch without Envelope is rejected.
invariants.statement: Every autonomous Run references an approved Execution Envelope.
invariants.title: Bounded autonomy

acceptance_criteria: Two attempts use isolated workspaces and promotion controls.
invariants.statement: Modifying Attempts execute in controlled isolated workspaces.
invariants.title: Workspace isolation

acceptance_criteria: Provider success alone cannot mark ProjectJob accepted.
invariants.statement: Attempt FINISHED never equals Project acceptance.
invariants.title: Completion is not acceptance

acceptance_criteria: ATLAS/provider success remains unaccepted until gate evaluation.
invariants.statement: External execution success cannot directly accept Project result.
invariants.title: Infrastructure success is not Project acceptance

acceptance_criteria: Unlimited autonomy configuration is invalid.
invariants.statement: There is no unbounded autonomy level.
invariants.title: No unlimited autonomy

acceptance_criteria: Material architecture change cannot execute before approval.
invariants.statement: Strategic/material decisions require approval.
invariants.title: Materiality governs escalation

acceptance_criteria: Independent workstream continues while blocked branch waits.
invariants.statement: A blocked material decision pauses only affected work where safe.
invariants.title: Dependency-local blocking

acceptance_criteria: Reconnect and observe active authorized Run.
invariants.statement: Persistent execution is inspectable and controllable.
invariants.title: Autonomous but observable

acceptance_criteria: PAUSED blocks dispatch while control/read access remains.
invariants.statement: Platform can stop new autonomous dispatch while preserving recoverability.
invariants.title: Global Safe Pause

acceptance_criteria: Detected-only provider cannot dispatch.
invariants.statement: Detected/configured/authenticated/healthy/registered/available are distinct.
invariants.title: Provider readiness explicit

acceptance_criteria: Healthy but policy-ineligible provider is excluded.
invariants.statement: Globally available does not imply eligibility for every ProjectJob.
invariants.title: Contextual provider eligibility

acceptance_criteria: Interaction-only client cannot execute/approve beyond delegation.
invariants.statement: Interaction role does not grant execution or approval authority.
invariants.title: UI and provider authority distinct

acceptance_criteria: Secret scanning finds no values in semantic/docs/evidence artifacts.
invariants.statement: Secrets are external to Project Git/docs/general context.
invariants.title: Secret exclusion

acceptance_criteria: Runtime/config drift cannot rewrite architecture automatically.
invariants.statement: Observations create divergence/proposals.
invariants.title: Observed reality cannot silently redefine intent

acceptance_criteria: Recommendation leaves target Project unchanged until adoption.
invariants.statement: Cross-project knowledge remains advisory until Project adoption.
invariants.title: Organizational Knowledge advisory

acceptance_criteria: Delete/rebuild projections with no semantic loss.
invariants.statement: Docs/dashboards/indexes never own Project truth.
invariants.title: Projections non-authoritative

acceptance_criteria: New Project has baseline before execution.
invariants.statement: Every Project immediately has documentation/dashboard state.
invariants.title: Docs/dashboard baseline at Project creation

acceptance_criteria: Provider success cannot mutate accepted semantic revision directly.
invariants.statement: ARTIFEX owns Project semantics and Project acceptance.
invariants.title: ARTIFEX Project authority

acceptance_criteria: No direct access to governed resource path.
invariants.statement: ATLAS owns assigned governed infrastructure/resource authority.
invariants.title: ATLAS infrastructure authority

acceptance_criteria: Direct private path is ineligible.
invariants.statement: ATLAS-governed resources cannot be bypassed without authorized governance transition.
invariants.title: ATLAS non-bypass

acceptance_criteria: Schema/conformance rejects ID conflation.
invariants.statement: ProjectJob/Attempt IDs are distinct from ATLAS ExecutionJob IDs.
invariants.title: Cross-platform identity separation

acceptance_criteria: Lease lifecycle authority remains ATLAS.
invariants.statement: ARTIFEX Core does not create canonical ATLAS ComputeLease state.
invariants.title: No competing ComputeLease

acceptance_criteria: Unit-only adapter cannot be marked delivered.
invariants.statement: Component implementation does not equal delivered capability.
invariants.title: Component evidence not delivery

acceptance_criteria: Custom internal composition cannot satisfy release Journey.
invariants.statement: Release-critical claims require actual shipping-composition outcomes.
invariants.title: Black-box release acceptance

glossary.Project Authority: Only authority that accepts Project semantic mutations
glossary.Projection: Rebuildable documentation or dashboard view, never authority
